topic: Scientific Models and the Particle Model of Matter
key_concepts: Scientists use models to represent things too small or too large for direct observation.
Models help communicate observations and ideas to other people.
Models can be physical or mathematical.
Models are used to make and test predictions.
Models can support or disprove hypotheses.
Models save time, money, and lives by offering safer, quicker, and less expensive alternat
Models help illustrate, explain, support, or challenge scientific theories.
Models are revised and updated as technology advances.
All matter is made of tiny particles too small to see.
Particles in solids are closely packed and hardly move.
Particles in gases are widely spaced and move freely.
